description: Read your Withings scale, blood pressure, sleep, activity, workout and ECG data, and start workflows when a new reading, night or workout arrives.

withings_new_activity_day_trigger.description: Runs once a day is over, with that day's steps, distance, floors, active time and calories.

output.activity: Everything Withings gives for the day

withings_new_blood_pressure_trigger.description: Runs when a Withings blood pressure monitor records a new reading for you, with heart rate when it measures it.

output.attribution: How it was attributed, such as Taken by a device
output.measures: Each measure with its type, label and value
output.modified_at: When it was last changed (ISO 8601, UTC)
output.readings: Every measure in it by name, as real numbers

withings_new_body_measurement_trigger.description: Runs when a Withings scale records a new weight or body composition reading for you. Readings already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.attribution: How it was attributed, such as Taken by a device
output.fat_ratio_percent: Fat ratio (%), on scales that measure it
output.measures: Each measure with its type, label and value
output.modified_at: When it was last changed (ISO 8601, UTC)
output.readings: Every measure in it by name, as real numbers

withings_new_ecg_trigger.description: Runs when an ECG is recorded with a ScanWatch, Move ECG or BPM Core, with its atrial fibrillation result.

output.afib: Atrial fibrillation result: Negative, Positive or Inconclusive
output.diastolic_bp_mmhg: Diastolic blood pressure, from a BPM Core
output.signal_id: The recording's signal id, for 'Get ECG recording'
output.systolic_bp_mmhg: Systolic blood pressure, from a BPM Core

withings_new_sleep_summary_trigger.description: Runs when a night's sleep summary arrives, from a Withings watch or sleep analyzer.

output.data: Everything Withings gives for the night
output.date: The day it is filed under (YYYY-MM-DD)
output.wakeupcount: How many times they woke up

withings_new_temperature_trigger.description: Runs when a new temperature is recorded, such as with a Withings thermometer.

output.attribution: How it was attributed, such as Taken by a device
output.measures: Each measure with its type, label and value
output.modified_at: When it was last changed (ISO 8601, UTC)
output.readings: Every measure in it by name, as real numbers

withings_new_workout_trigger.description: Runs when a workout is recorded, such as a run, ride or swim.

output.category_name: What kind of workout, such as Run
output.data: Everything Withings gives for the workout
